snippet.title: Teeny Quests - Beta Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Teeny Quests is a browser-based isometric adventure/puzzle game. More than that, it's an application for people to make tiny games of their own, quests that other people can play. 

What are you waiting for? Adventure is calling!

Apologies for the exclamation point. I find that kind of thing irritating, too, but that underscores how much I'm willing to debase myself to get you to click on the linky-poo in in the list below.

- Play the game: http://teenyquests.ridiculopathy.com
- Peek at the code: https://github.com/markarenz/teeny-quests-angular
- More about the project: https://www.markmakesstuff.com/posts/choose-your-own-quest/
- Sound effect credits: https://teenyquests.ridiculopathy.com/sound-credits
